image_description: A close-up shot of a baby wearing a black bib with white trim. The bib features two distinct printed graphics: a yellow/green textured shape on the left (resembling a stylized animal or object) and a photorealistic face of a person wearing a crown on the right, surrounded by white floral patterns. The baby is holding the straps of the bib near their neck. The background is a plain white surface.
